body:
Corrected mis-scope of 'play death animation backwards' from a literal kinematic get-up animation to a synthesized .gband reference clip -- founder real-time correction: reversing the death animation was supposed to be the oracle the RL learns against, not the get-up motion itself (the point-mass spike isn't rigid body, so it can't 'fall over' in a sense that makes reverse playback directly usable). tools/ragdoll_spike/main.c now records the forward fall and writes it reversed as a real .gband binary+manifest, verified loadable via GOLDENBAND's own gb_init/gb_verify (PASS, 192 ticks x 195 channels, arc runs lying->standing). docs2/RAGDOLL_ORIENTATION_NORTHSTAR.md updated as a third recovery path; also answers founder's separate 'roll over animation' point (not needed for this mechanism). Commit ab474aa.

⚓ ☃
title: Ragdoll get-up oracle: reversed-fall .gband reference clip for RL imitation reward (S497)
